title: Retention period, retention timer type, S7 contract element names, closure reason value and screen field names of the retention closure are not stated in the sources
source: RWB-E6-025; FSD S7 v3 A2.13; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-WO-36, R-WO-47, R-WO-48; TSD P3 v3 T2.3, T2.4, T5.3; Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8 DF-CAS-022, DF-CAS-023, DF-WRK-030, LOV-TIMER, LOV-CLOSURE; RWB-S7-E6025-CON
description: The legacy story RWB-E6-025 and its module feature FEAT-WOF-13 name the retention closure through the two rules R-WO-36 and R-WO-47 but state no value for the retention period, no retention timer type, no transport or element name for the write-off answers, and no screen field order for SCR-27. LOV-TIMER of the Logical Data Model holds nine timer types and none of them is a retention timer; the retention period appears in no parameter table read for this work package; the closure reason column DF-CAS-023 offers eight LOV-CLOSURE values and the feature names none of them; the TSD P3 v3 names the timers port and the workflow package but not the two write-off operations; and the Epics 3 to 8 story carries no requirement ID. The story therefore uses the placeholders of Template and Rules R9 and states the behaviour it can prove without inventing a value.
evidence: FSD S7 v3 A2.13 lists R-WO-36 and R-WO-47 with their outcomes and no period, no timer type and no contract; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-36 and R-WO-47 give the from-state, the event and the to-state only; LDM v8 LOV-TIMER holds SERVICE_LEVEL, NOTICE_PERIOD, CURE_PERIOD, PRESCRIPTION, HEARING_DEADLINE, OFFER_VALIDITY, HOLDING_AGE, CLAIM_DEADLINE and INSTALLMENT_DUE; DF-WRK-030 describes the timer type as service level, notice period, cure period, prescription, hearing deadline, offer validity, holding age and claim deadline; TSD P3 v3 T2.3 gives the Java TimerScheduler port and T5.3 the seven published events; RWB-E6-025 lists two legacy endpoints, both of them the write-off service's, and no requirement ID.
owner_role: TechX, rwb-writeoff contract owner and rwb-case reference-data owner (RW-COE)
proposed: Fix the retention period as a parameter row per product group, add the retention timer type to LOV-TIMER, confirm the two S7 operations and their element names in RWB-S7-E6025-CON, and confirm the closure reason and the SCR-27 field order at contract and reference-data review; rename in this story without changing a value, a rule or a test if they differ.
